name: armasu-builder-words
description: Find Armasu interface sentences that use a word only the people who build or run the app would use, where a shopper expects everyday words

builder_word.instructions: `text` is a sentence shown to shoppers in a wardrobe and shopping app. Does it use a word or phrase that only someone who built or runs the app would say, where a shopper expects an everyday word? Builder words include: logic, refusal, payload, endpoint, route, flag, cookie, snapshot, null, sync, backend, query, cache, fallback, config, schema, id, stub, server, session, token, request body, status code, override. The app's own product words are fine and are not builder words: closet, wishlist, tray, try-on slot, slot, fit, Fit of the Day, look, piece, handle, ring, render, bag, beta, invite.
